newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's bank H1 net profit top $8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's bank H1 net profit top $8 mln.

text.p: Morocco's bank Credit du Maroc said on Monday it registered 70.2 million dirhams ($8.06 million) net profits in the first half of the year, up 17.7 percent compared with the previous period in 1995.
The bank made 59.6 million dirhams profits in the first half of 1995.
CDM's turnover in the first half of 1996 rose to 517.3 million dirhams from 486.7 million in the same period last year.

The bank's deposits reached 9.09 billion dirhams at the end of June 1996, up 8.5 percent compared with the first half of 1995, Casablanca-based stockbroker Casablanca Finance Intermediation (CFI) said.
Established in Casablanca in 1963, Credit du Maroc has a capital of 833.8 million dirhams and nearly 100 offices throughout the country. It employs a staff of more than 1,600.
One of the eight active banks listed on the Casablanca stock market, CDM's shares were last traded at 350 dirhams.
It has a market capitalisation of 2.9 billion dirhams, CFI said.
